This skill bundles executable Python scripts (listed above). Enabling the skill lets the agent PROPOSE running them — every run still needs your approval, runs in the skill\'s sandbox with no access to your keys, and scripts may use the network. Only enable skills whose scripts you have read and trust.
Skills are untrusted instruction data. They never receive your keys, and tool actions stay behind the approval gate.
One approval covers exactly the items listed. Uncheck any item to exclude it — excluded items are dropped and logged. Anything new the agent proposes afterwards will ask again.

Provider/model catalog is built into the app and updated with app releases (free tiers change often).

Miftah pools the free tiers of several LLM providers behind one key, one local endpoint, an agent with read-only tools, and importable SKILL.md skills.

Inspired by FreeLLMAPI (github.com/tashfeenahmed/freellmapi, MIT License) — reimplemented natively for Android; no original code is bundled. Your keys stay encrypted on this device and are never sent anywhere except the provider they belong to.

No ads. No analytics.
Invalid key (HTTP %1$d) — the provider rejected it. The key was NOT deleted.
Key accepted, but rate-limited right now (HTTP 429). Try again later.
Provider server error (HTTP %1$d) — this is on the provider, try again later.
Network error — could not reach the provider.
Miftah needs one free provider key to start chatting. Four quick steps:
1. Pick any provider from the list below — every one has a free tier.
2. Open the provider\'s page and create a free API key:
3. Tap the provider below, paste the key into the Add-key form, and save it.
4. Press Test next to the saved key to confirm it works — then come back to Chat.
New here? You need one free provider key to start.
Could not check for updates (no connection or server error).
Used today: %1$d · totals cover %2$d of %3$d providers (the rest don\'t document a limit)

Estimates from the providers\' documented free tiers — providers expose no live balance, so treat these as planning figures, not exact balances. Each provider\'s figure is the sum of its catalog models\' documented daily limits; per-account/project tiers are counted once, never multiplied by the number of keys.
No provider keys yet. Add a free key in the Keys tab and your combined balance will appear here.

Saved services let the agent call real APIs (e.g. Gumroad) through the http_request tool. Keys are stored encrypted, injected by the app, and never shown to the model. Every call still needs your approval.
